texts.about.title: We Make Global Education
texts.about.description: Founded in 2010, we have helped over 10,000 students from 50+ countries achieve their academic dreams. We're more than consultants — we're your partners in global success.
texts.about.missionP1: We believe every motivated student deserves access to world-class education, regardless of their background. Our mission is to eliminate barriers and confusion from the international education journey.
texts.about.missionP2: From your first inquiry to graduation day, we're with you every step — selecting the right university, crafting a compelling application, securing your visa, and settling into life abroad.

texts.about.title: We Make Global Education
texts.about.description: Founded in 2010, we have helped over 10,000 students from 50+ countries achieve their academic dreams. We're more than consultants — we're your partners in global success.
texts.about.missionP1: We believe every motivated student deserves access to world-class education, regardless of their background. Our mission is to eliminate barriers and confusion from the international education journey.
texts.about.missionP2: From your first inquiry to graduation day, we're with you every step — selecting the right university, crafting a compelling application, securing your visa, and settling into life abroad.
texts.about.studentFirstDesc: Every decision we make centers on student success and wellbeing.
texts.about.excellenceDesc: We maintain the highest standards in guidance and support.
texts.about.innovationDesc: Using technology to streamline the application journey.
